Earlier consensus pinned initial full-year net profits to Fiscal Year 2028 (estimated around $13.2M), but heavier upfront financing needs have led some analysts to push a firm breakeven projection out to 2029 (where profits are forecasted to surge to ~$375M). • Backlog Execution: Growth expectations are backed by a reported $31 billion to $36 billion long-term contracted backlog, primarily anchored by a massive 15-year lease agreement with AI hyperscaler CoreWeave. • Near-Term Catalyst: Applied Digital is scheduled to report its official Q1 FY2027 quarterly numbers on October 7, 2026, after the market closes. This print will be heavily scrutinized to see how well data center delivery timelines are aligning with revenue generation.

Author: Monnaa
Text: $APLD Nasdaq futures are jumping tonight mainly because Micron delivered a very strong earnings report and outlook, reinforcing that AI demand and data-center spending remain strong, while softer-than-expected core PCE inflation reduced concerns about the Fed staying restrictive. Together, that is giving investors renewed confidence in the AI trade and pushing tech stocks higher. For APLD, this is potentially positive because it directly strengthens the broader AI/data-center demand narrative.
